allow: PowerShell($root = \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3000/ -UseBasicParsing\).StatusCode; $dash = \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3000/dashboard -UseBasicParsing\).StatusCode; $trip = \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3000/trip -UseBasicParsing\).StatusCode; "/=$root dashboard=$dash trip=$trip")

PowerShell($body = '{"destination":"Phuket, Thailand","members":["Alex","Beam"],"budget":15000,"preferences":["beach","foodie"]}'; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:3000/api/ai/itinerary -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -UseBasicParsing; "status=$\($r.StatusCode\) length=$\($r.Content.Length\)"; \($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json\).source)

PowerShell($r1 = \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3002/ -UseBasicParsing\).StatusCode; $r2 = \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3002/dashboard -UseBasicParsing\).StatusCode; $r3 = \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3002/trip -UseBasicParsing\).StatusCode; "/=$r1 dashboard=$r2 trip=$r3")

PowerShell($r1 = \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3004/ -UseBasicParsing\).StatusCode; $r2 = \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3004/dashboard -UseBasicParsing\).StatusCode; $r3 = \(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3004/trip -UseBasicParsing\).StatusCode; "/=$r1 dashboard=$r2 trip=$r3")

PowerShell(Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.InterfaceAlias -match 'Wi-Fi|Ethernet' -and $_.IPAddress -notmatch '^169' } | Select-Object IPAddress, InterfaceAlias | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,8081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { $proc = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ Port = $_.LocalPort; PID = $_.OwningProcess; Name = $proc.Name } } | Format-Table -AutoSize)
